- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Common traffic issues in Tokyo include congestion, accidents, pollution, parking, and pedestrian safety.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The government is addressing congestion by improving public transportation, promoting car-sharing and bike-sharing, and encouraging flexible work hours or work from home options.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The government is addressing accidents by implementing stricter traffic enforcement measures, increasing fines and penalties for traffic violations, and promoting traffic safety education.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The government is addressing pollution by encouraging the use of electric and hybrid vehicles, controlling emissions from vehicles, and promoting public transportation and bicycles.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The government is addressing parking issues by increasing parking fees, promoting car-sharing services, and building more multi-level parking lots.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The government is addressing pedestrian safety by implementing traffic calming measures, building more pedestrian crossings, and promoting pedestrian safety education.
